options.name: שער וקשתות — Gate and arcade
options.idea: Source: the client's own hero picture (three round arches, the golden canopy standing inside an arch) and the three arched windows on his beit-midrash object. One shape at every scale: a round-headed arch with straight legs. A big framed 'gate' window holds the hero photo; quick actions become arch 'doors'; object pictures sit in arch windows; chart columns get arch heads; tabs are small arches standing on a floor line; a colonnade (row of arches) divides sections instead of waves; nested tonal arches behind the gate ('sunrise') replace blobs. Symmetric and architectural where the reference is organic and asymmetric, yet still round, friendly and big.
options.risk: Misreadings in a religious context: an arch-topped slab carrying a name or a date reads as a headstone; exactly two arch tablets side by side read as the Tablets of the Law; pointed, horseshoe or lobed arches read as a mihrab. Needs hard rules (semicircular heads only, never a name/date inside an arch, never a pair, never taller than about 1:1.25). Arch heads eat height, so they suit tiles and pictures but not wide data panels. The arch look is fashionable in boutique/wedding branding and turns twee if every card is an arch. Small repeated arches look like lace or an awning: keep them large with visible gaps. Must stay flat and abstract (no capitals, bricks, handles, 3D shading) or it becomes a code-drawn building, which the client forbade.

options.name: חותם וטבעות — Seal rings and milled edge
options.idea: Source: the seal itself. Concentric rings (thick gold rim, black band, thin inner ring), a reeded coin edge made of short radial ticks, text running around a ring, the crown position as an apex mark. Round tiles with a milled edge, ring gauges, concentric-ring backdrops, a strip of fine vertical reeding as a divider.
options.risk: Weakest differentiation: circles, ringed medallions and a round text stamp are exactly the reference's signature, so changing ring weight or swapping dots for reeding is a detail change, not a new device. It also cheapens the real seal (many imitation seals around the true one), Hebrew ring text is illegible at small sizes, and bevel/metal gradients drift into kitsch. The crown and filigree cannot be redrawn in code (pictorial) so the most recognisable parts of the seal are unusable anyway.

options.name: שיבוץ זהב — Gold inlay, plaques and corner pieces
options.idea: Source: the client's black-and-gold objects (charity-box panels, book spines, the slate's metal corners, the trophy base plate). A thin gold line set a few pixels inside the edge of a panel; engraved 'plaques' with scooped (concave) corners; L-shaped gold corner brackets; and a small diamond (the rhombus at the centre of each book-spine panel) as the universal point marker. Rectilinear, so it suits figures, tables, charts and forms.
options.risk: Alone it turns formal (certificate, whisky label, Art-Deco hotel) and loses 'happy, big, round'; a page of rectangles invites the client's 'Excel' complaint again. It shines mostly on black, which fights the light direction he chose. Hairline gold on white is low contrast, so it may only decorate, never carry state.

recommended:
Recommend one combined system, working name "שער הזהב" (replace the version name "גל זהב", since the wave is retired): option 1 is the form language, option 3 is the detail layer, and option 2 is reduced to exactly one round thing, the real seal via var(--tz-logo).

Role rules that keep it simple:
- ARCH = something you go through or look through: the hero gate, action doors, picture windows, tabs, chart columns.
- PLAQUE / INLAY = something you read: figures, badges, tooltips, toasts, cards, buttons, rows.
- DIAMOND = a point: markers, bullets, slider thumbs, ticks, status dots, confetti.
- FLOOR LINE = a straight 3px ink rule that arches stand on.
Signature idea nobody else has: the frame of the hero gate IS the campaign gauge, and it advances when a deposit is saved.

Guardrails: semicircular heads with straight legs only; never a person's name or a date inside an arch (member cards, member sheet, list rows stay rectangular); never exactly two arches side by side (use 3 or 6); keep arches flat and abstract; do not redraw the crown or scrolls in code.

Retire everything the reference owns, including items the brief did not list but b1 still copies: wave ribbons and wave-masked photo, the header's yellow corner and white swoosh, the yellow tint over the photo, translucent circles/blobs, circular medallion buttons and every double ring, the round dotted text stamp, brush-stroke tab, line-with-dot and dot-behind-first-letter headings, the light-line + bold-line heading pair, the sharp yellow rectangle button with a double chevron, underline-only inputs, the giant white circle form with a small circle overlapping it, the circle chart container, the bubble cluster of figures, the wavy dotted gift road, the row pattern 'white circle + label + chevron'.

Keep the current palette tokens (--y ...). Add --wood:#17120B (warm black, from the dark wood in his picture), --inlay:#C8921A (hairline gold on white; use var(--y-lite) on black), --floor:3px. Add Suez One to fonts.txt for headings.

CSS gotcha for every arch: do not write border-radius:999px 999px 16px 16px (the browser scales all four radii together and the bottom corners collapse). Fix the aspect-ratio and use percentages: border-radius:50% 50% R R / V V R R with V = 50% x (width/height), e.g. 41.667% for 5/6, 40% for 4/5.

Defects seen in the current screenshots that the re-skin should not carry over: the monthly chart plot is empty (d-dashboard-tall and m-dashboard-tall); object pictures show their white square outside the circles (coins in the figures, kupa in the deposit modal); several picture circles are empty in m-dashboard-tall (kibbutz, cheder, tiyul, matana, gavia, kupa); milestone labels overlap in the member view; the deposit save button stacks its label above its chevron.

No files were edited. Study material I generated is only in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/23f26262-7397-509f-9a5e-29915b59e94f/scratchpad/motif-view/.

system.dividersAndHero:
Remove .hero-wave*, .rib*, .blob, wave .edge-t/.edge-b, .hd-swoosh/.hd-corner, .hero-tint and all drifting shapes. Only three dividers exist:
(D1) Floor line: straight 3px ink rule wherever two colour fields meet (header/hero, band edges). Tabs, doors and chart columns stand on it.
(D2) Colonnade: the hero-to-page divider is the row of six action doors straddling the hero's bottom edge (half on gold, half on white), so the divider is content, not ornament. One decorative repeat is allowed, on top of the closing deposit band: a flex row of 7 flat gold blocks (3 on phones) sitting on the band, each flex:1; height:132px; border-radius:50% 50% 0 0 / 88px 88px 0 0; gap 36px.
(D3) Inlay rule between two white sections: 1.5px line in --inlay across the wrap, fading at both ends, with three diamonds at its centre (10px ink between two 6px gold).
Band rhythm on the dashboard: gold hero / white figures / one --wood band (דורש טיפול + פעילות אחרונה; faint vertical panel lines: repeating-linear-gradient 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04) every 160px; if the client finds it heavy, swap the single token to --y-mist with ink text) / white frameworks / gold band with straight edges (הכנסות) / white (מתנות, מובילים, לוח הפקדות) / gold closing band with the colonnade top / black footer.
Hero: flat var(--grad) field, no photo behind text, no tint. Backdrop 'זריחה': three nested tonal arches behind the gate, same proportions, scaled 1.2 / 1.42 / 1.66 from bottom-centre, fills rgba(255,255,255,.18/.12/.07), clipped by the hero, plus a soft radial glow rgba(255,244,214,.55) at the gate.
The gate: hero photo in an arch window, aspect 4/5, border-radius:50% 50% 14px 14px / 40% 40% 14px 14px, overflow hidden, object-fit cover, object-position 50% 45% (this centres the client's canopy: an arch inside an arch), true colours. A 12px frame around it is the campaign gauge (see badge). Under it a 'threshold' slab: 14px high, gate width + 36px, ink, radius 3px, with a 1.5px gold line through its middle.
system.actionTiles:
Arch 'doors' replace the circular medallions.
Shape: aspect-ratio 5/6; desktop 150x180 (168x202 from 1680px); border-radius:50% 50% 16px 16px / 41.667% 41.667% 16px 16px. Surface white, var(--sh-1). Inlay: ::before inset 7px, border 1.5px solid var(--inlay), border-radius 50% 50% 10px 10px / 41% 41% 10px 10px, and a 7px gold diamond centred on the inlay's apex.
Content: the existing plain glyph at 28px centred at about 36% of the height; label Heebo 800 16px/1.15, max two lines, centred at about 68%.
Primary (רישום הפקדה): ink fill, var(--y-lite) inlay and glyph, white label, 12% larger, first in reading order.
Layout: desktop one row of six, 24px gaps, centred on the wrap, margin-top:-90px so the row straddles the hero's bottom edge; a 3px floor line across the wrap under the row. Phone: 3 columns x 2 rows, 10px gaps (tile about 104-114px wide, label 14px), first row straddling the hero edge. Never a 2-column grid.
States: hover = 'the light goes on': a gold layer (::after) wipes up from the floor, clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) to inset(0), 260ms ease-out; the door rises 6px, shadow var(--sh-2), glyph and label turn ink. Primary inverts to gold fill with ink text. Press: back down, scale .97. Focus-visible: 3px ink outline, offset 4px, same radii.
Reuse: the phone floating action = the same door at 56x67 (ink, gold plus) replacing the ringed circle; empty states use a 96x115 door.
system.badge:
The round dotted stamp is replaced by two parts.
(1) Gate gauge: the hero gate's 12px frame. Wrapper = photo + 12px padding, with an SVG overlay sized by JS (ResizeObserver). For box W x H and stroke s: d = M (W-s/2),H V (W/2) A ((W-s)/2) ((W-s)/2) 0 0 0 (s/2),(W/2) V H, i.e. it starts at the bottom right (the RTL start), climbs the right leg, goes over the head and down the left leg. Track stroke rgba(11,11,11,.16). Fill: same path, ink, pathLength=100, stroke-dasharray 100 100, stroke-dashoffset = 100 - percent, plus a second copy 2px wide in var(--y-lite) as an inlay line down its middle. A 16px gold diamond with a 3px ink border sits at path.getPointAtLength(total x percent). At 57% it rests just past the apex. At 100% the frame turns gold with an ink centre line.
(2) Plaque: an engraved plate attached to the diamond, 14px outside the arch (phones: fixed at the gate's top-start corner, 88x52). Desktop 108x64, fill --wood, scooped corners built from four radial-gradients, one per quadrant: radial-gradient(circle 9px at 0 0, transparent 98%, var(--wood) 100%) 0 0 / 51% 51% no-repeat, and the mirrored three. Inside: ::before inset 6px, border 1.5px solid var(--y-lite), radius 3px. Text: '57%' Heebo 900 30px in var(--y-lite), 'מהיעד' Heebo 600 12px white.
The same plaque in size S (56x36) is the system's only badge shape: framework percentages, 'ללא יעד', alert counts, tooltips, the toast. No text on a path anywhere; the only ring text left is inside the real seal.
system.activeTabAndAccents:
Active tab = a small gate on a floor line (replaces the brush stroke).
Desktop nav: items are plain ink text aligned to the header's 3px bottom rule. One absolutely positioned element .gate (height 44px, border-radius 22px 22px 0 0, ink fill) stands on the rule behind the active label; active label var(--y-lite), Heebo 800. It slides between items (transform + width, 380ms var(--spring)). Hover on an inactive item: a var(--y-pale) arch of the same shape rises (scaleY 0 to 1, origin bottom, 180ms).
Sub-tabs and status filter chips: a row on a 2px ink floor line; active = the same ink arch tab (height 40px, radius 20px 20px 0 0); count in a small gold rounded rectangle (radius 6px) with ink digits. On the --wood band the active tab is gold with ink text and the floor line is gold.
Segmented control (מזומן / אשראי): two tabs on a floor line, active = ink arch tab.
Phone bottom bar: white, 2px ink top rule; the active item is an ink arch (64x56, radius 28px 28px 0 0) standing on the bar's bottom edge with a gold glyph and an 11px white label.
Accents: every decorative dot becomes a diamond (a square rotated 45deg): 6px in status tags (colour = status), 8px green for 'נשמר', 10px list bullets, 16px slider and progress thumbs. Monograms and the user chip are rounded-square 'signets' (radius 12-14px, ink or gold fill, 1.5px inlay line inset 4px), never circles and never arches. Icon buttons (refresh, print, export, close) are 44px rounded squares, radius 12px, 1.5px ink border; hover fills gold. Inputs are boxed (56px, white, 1.5px ink border, radius 12px; focus: 2px ink border + 0 0 0 3px var(--y-pale)), not underline-only. Focus-visible everywhere: 3px ink outline, offset 3px (var(--y-lite) on dark).
system.firstScreenComposition:
Reference home: centred headline over a full-bleed tinted photo, a centred 4x2 grid of ringed circles, corner waves, a round stamp. Ours: a solid gold field with a framed gate, a number, and a colonnade of doors at the fold. Symmetric and architectural, no photo behind text, no circles except the seal.
Desktop 1440x900:
- Header 72px, white, straight, closed by the 3px floor line. Seal 84px at the start (right), its centre on the floor line so it hangs half over the hero like a pendant: 5px white ring + var(--sh-2), no second ring. Wordmark beside it (Suez One 22px; 'עזרת חתנים' Heebo 500 14px). Nav centred on the floor line. At the end (left): 'נשמר' with a green diamond, refresh square, year selector (rectangle, radius 12px, 1.5px ink border), user signet + name.
- Hero height H = clamp(560px, 100dvh - 200px, 700px), gold.
- Start column (right, about 620px), vertically centred in the top 520px: eyebrow 'קמפיין תשפ״ו · 10/11/2026'; the number at clamp(88px, 9.2vw, 136px) Heebo 900; 'נאספו השנה' in Suez One 64px; one line '57% מהיעד · חסר ₪121,300' (no slider bar here, the gate is the gauge); a black primary button 'רישום הפקדה' + a text link 'לרשימת הבחורים'; the last-deposit strip (rounded rectangle radius 12px, rgba(255,255,255,.7), a small ink plaque label, a pulsing ink diamond).
- End column (left): the gate, height H - 200px (500x400 at 900px tall), top 28px below the header, standing on its threshold slab, sunrise arches behind it, the 57% plaque riding its frame.
- Fold: the six doors in one row, straddling the hero's bottom edge, on a floor line (ends around y=862). Below that the figures section begins.
Phone 390x844: header 60px (seal 44px, year selector, signet); gold hero with the gate first, centred, 216x270, sunrise behind; then eyebrow, number 68px, caption Suez 34px, the percent line, a full-width 56px black button; the first row of three doors straddles the hero's bottom edge and is visible above the bottom bar.
Next block (figures) so the page does not fall back to bubbles: a 'wall of plaques' bento, 5 columns x 2 rows on desktop: one large gold plaque (2x2) for נגבה השנה with the coins picture in an arch window and a mini arcade of the last months; five small plaques (יעד כולל white, חסר להשלמה --wood with gold number, עמדו ביעד pale, חובות משנים קודמות white with red diamond, אחוז התקדמות with a mini arch gauge) and one plaque for the cash/credit split. Each plaque has scooped corners, an inlay line, a 44px number, a context line. Phone: 2 columns.
system.headings:
Two voices: letters in Suez One, numerals in Heebo. Add https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Suez+One&display=swap to fonts.txt; stack 'Suez One','Heebo','Arial Hebrew',Arial,sans-serif. Check that it appears under fontsLoaded and that the gershayim and the shekel sign render; fallback if the client finds it too traditional: Heebo 900 in the same single-weight layout.
Section title: one colour (ink; white on the --wood band), one weight, Suez One clamp(32px, 3.4vw, 50px), line-height 1.08, at most two lines, start-aligned. Above it an eyebrow in Heebo 600 16-18px (ink at 70%). No thin first line + bold second line, no line-with-dot, no dot behind the first letter.
Accent 'פינות זהב' (from the metal corners on his slate and box): two L-shaped brackets hugging the heading block. ::before at the top-start corner (border-top + border-inline-start: 3px solid var(--y), 20px legs, 10px outside the text box) and ::after at the bottom-end corner. On gold surfaces the brackets are ink; on --wood they are var(--y-lite).
Screen titles ('בחורים'): Suez One clamp(64px, 9vw, 128px), same brackets at 28px legs.
Numbers anywhere (hero, plaques, tables, chart labels): Heebo 800-900 with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Body Heebo 400-500; labels Heebo 700.
system.buttons:
Shape: rounded rectangle, radius 14px; heights 56 / 46 / 38px; padding-inline 26px; Heebo 800 17px. No sharp yellow rectangle and no double chevron.
Primary on gold or white: ink fill, white label, an inlay line (::before inset 5px, 1.5px solid var(--y), radius 10px), and at the inline end a 26px gold diamond holding a single ink arrow pointing in the reading direction (the glyph counter-rotated so it stays upright).
Primary on --wood: var(--grad) fill, ink label, inlay line ink at 35%, ink diamond with a gold arrow.
Primary inside white cards where black is too heavy (framework cards): gold fill, ink label, ink inlay line at 35%.
Secondary: transparent, 2px ink border, ink label; hover fills ink with a white label.
Text link: Heebo 700 ink, underline 3px var(--y) with offset 6px (2px ink underline on gold), single arrow.
States: hover lifts 2px with var(--sh-2), the inlay line moves from inset 5px to 3px, the diamond turns 90deg and moves 4px in the reading direction; press scale .97; focus-visible 3px ink outline offset 3px; disabled 45% opacity with no inlay.
Fix while re-skinning: the deposit save button must keep label and arrow on one line (inline-flex, align-items:center, gap 12px, white-space:nowrap).
system.picturesFraming:
No circles, no wave masks, no colour tint, no text on photos.
Scenes (16:9): shown through arch windows. Hero = the single gate. Banners of the six 'בקרוב' screens = a triptych window, echoing the three arches in his own picture: three overflow:hidden arch divs, widths 1 : 1.5 : 1, the middle one 12% taller, 16px gaps, inside a container with a fixed aspect-ratio of 16/7; each holds the same img positioned absolutely at the full group width and shifted by its own offset, so one continuous picture runs behind three openings. Each opening has an 8px ink frame. The screen title sits on a --wood plaque overlapping the base of the middle window, so no gradient scrim is needed.
Objects (square, white background): arch windows with aspect 5/6, border-radius 50% 50% 16px 16px / 41.667% 41.667% 16px 16px, overflow hidden, img object-fit contain with 12% padding. On pure white the window is #FFF. On any light tint (var(--y-mist), var(--y-pale)) set mix-blend-mode:multiply on the img so the picture's white square disappears; never place objects on saturated gold or black. Frame: 1.5px --inlay line inset 7px, var(--sh-1); where the picture stands for progress (framework cards) the frame is the same arch gauge as the hero at 8px.
Placements: coins inside the large figures plaque; gedola / ktana / kibbutz / cheder in 2x2 horizontal framework cards (window at the start side, numbers and progress at the end side, instead of the four centred columns with a yellow button); tiyul and matana as small gates standing on the gifts beam; gavia beside the leaderboard; kupa at the apex of the deposit sheet and in the closing band.
Deposit sheet: a wide panel with a shallow vault top (border-radius 50% 50% 24px 24px / 120px 120px 24px 24px), not a circle. Member sheet and member cards: plain rectangles, radius 24px.
Placeholders: same arch, fill var(--y-mist), 1.5px --inlay line, small picture glyph, label and size centred.
system.dataVisuals:
Everything stands on a 3px ink floor line; no circular chart containers; panels are white rectangles (radius 20px) with an inlay line.
Yearly income: an arcade. Columns 44px wide; lower segment בחורים in gold with a flat top, upper segment פורים in ink with an arch head (radius 22px 22px 0 0), 3px white gap between. Expenses: a 10px ink diamond at the expense height on a 1.5px stem beside the column. Value above each column in Heebo 800 13px; the current year is 52px wide, has a var(--y-lite) inlay arch inside its head and its value on a small plaque.
Monthly collection: 12 gold arch columns (תשרי at the right), radius = half the width; the peak month in ink with a gold inlay. Last year = a 'ghost arch' behind each column: 1.5px outline in ink at 40%, 8px wider, no fill. Months without data: a 6px grey stub. Phone keeps vertical columns (16px wide, two-letter month labels at 10px). Hover/tap: a plaque tooltip with month, amount and a signed difference in a dir=ltr span.
Progress bars ('beam'): 10px track, radius 3px, rgba(11,11,11,.1); gold fill; a 16px ink diamond marker with a 2px white edge; at 100% the beam is ink with a gold diamond. Cash/credit: one beam in two segments (ink and gold) with a 3px gap and a diamond at the split.
Gift milestones: a straight 10px ink beam with a gold centre line from ₪0 to ₪2,400; two small gates (arch windows 132x158 with the tiyul and matana pictures) stand on it at ₪700 and ₪2,000; diamond ticks every ₪500; under each gate the threshold and how many students passed. In the member view the gold fill is his amount and passed gates light up (pale to gold).
Deposit heat-map as 'lit windows': cells 14x18px, radius 7px 7px 2px 2px, gap 4px; unlit #EFEFEF, then var(--y-pale), var(--y-lite), var(--y), ink for the top bucket; the Shabbat row is hollow (1px outline, no fill); today has a 2px ink outline.
Leaderboard: rank inside a 34px diamond with the number upright; first place is a gold plaque row with an ink inlay; a thin beam under each row shows the amount relative to first place.
Percent figures: a mini arch gauge (40x48). Member equation: plaques joined by + and = (base white, קנס on var(--bad-bg), נדרש gold, פער --wood with gold digits).
system.motion:
Delete tzb1-drift, tzb1-drift2, tzb1-liq, tzb1-brush, tzb1-stampin, tzb1-spin. Everything below starts on load (never on scroll) and is finished by 2.2s.
Load-in 'פתיחת השער':
0-300ms header in; floor lines draw from the start side (scaleX 0 to 1).
150-750ms sunrise arches scale .6 to 1 with opacity, origin 50% 100%, 90ms stagger, var(--spring).
250-950ms the gate opens: two ink leaves covering the photo slide apart (translateX +/-101%, cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)) while the photo eases from scale 1.08 to 1.
700-1700ms the gauge draws from 0 to 57% (stroke-dashoffset), the diamond rides the path (requestAnimationFrame + getPointAtLength), the plaque counts up and settles from a 6deg tip.
300-1500ms the hero number rolls like an odometer: each digit is a fixed-width reel (0.6em) moving vertically, 50ms stagger.
600-1300ms doors rise 40px from the floor, 60ms stagger, primary first.
Lower blocks at the same time: plaque numbers count up (800ms); chart columns grow from the floor (scaleY, origin bottom, 40ms stagger) and ghost arches fade in last; heat-map windows light up in a diagonal sweep (delay = (column + row) x 12ms).
Interaction: doors 'light on' wipe; plaques lift 4px and their inlay moves from inset 8px to 5px; the nav gate slides (380ms spring); tooltips pop (scale .9 to 1, 140ms); diamonds turn 90deg when their value changes; view changes cross-fade with a 16px rise.
Deposit saved: the sheet's frame fills to 100% gold in 600ms, the kupa picture bumps (scale 1 to 1.12 to 1), 14-18 small gold and ink diamonds burst from the apex and fall while rotating (abstract squares only), a plaque toast 'ההפקדה נשמרה' slides up; on the dashboard the odometer rolls up by the amount, the gate gauge advances with its diamond, and the affected plaques flash a gold rise.
Ambient: only a slow breathing of the glow behind the gate (opacity .45 to .7, 7s) and the last-deposit strip.
prefers-reduced-motion: final state at once, gate already open, no confetti, no breathing.
